Water Service & Traffic Advisory – Waverley Road – Water Main Repair

Local traffic only on Waverley Road between Jaybe Drive and Breeze Drive, Dartmouth, for an emergency water main repair. 

Water service will be temporarily shut down in this area. No estimate restoration time. 

Customers in the area may experience a reduction in water pressure and discoloured water. 

https://t.co/akXVb7ePQS
